bodyParagraphs: From fighting over the TV remote to sharing midnight treats, having you as my sister is one of life's sweetest gifts.
Thank you for listening to my nonsense, guiding me when I needed it, and having my back in every situation.
No matter where life takes us, this bond stays right here. Happy Raksha Bandhan, always.
